title: TaskSpec
description: Full specification of one assessment task. BACKEND ONLY: contains the reference solution pointer, hidden tests and certificate. The browser gets CandidateTaskView instead.

version.description: Revision of this task; bumped whenever the spec changes.

mode.description: seed: built from a hand-written seed repo or the DSA bank. llm: generated by the generator model.

seed_id.description: Seed repo or DSA bank entry the task was built from. Null when mode is llm.

runtime.description: Runtime id: a directory under runtimes/ (python311, node20). The runner image is assess-<id>.

dsa_tags.description: DSA topics exercised (same names as Portfolio.assessment.dsaTopicsSolved). Empty for domain tasks.

statement_md.description: Task statement shown to the candidate (Markdown).

repo_tour_md.description: Orientation to the starter repo (Markdown). Empty for DSA tasks.

reference_ref.description: Pointer to the reference solution in backend storage. Never the solution itself.

target_symbols.description: Symbols the solution must change, as path::qualname.

entry_symbols.description: Symbols where a candidate should start reading, as path::qualname.

visible_test_ids.description: Exact set of test ids (e.g. pytest node ids) the runner must collect from visible_tests, recorded when the task is built. Any other set means the run is not trusted: status error, reason test_set_mismatch.

fail_to_pass.description: Test ids that fail on the starter (the reference passes every test), recorded by the validation gate (backend/gate). Absent or null before the gate ran.

pass_to_pass.description: Test ids that already pass on the starter, recorded by the validation gate. Absent or null before the gate ran.

dsa_cases.description: Input/expected cases for DSA tasks. Null for domain tasks. For bank problems, hidden is the pool a session's hidden sample is drawn from (see SubmitPayload.hidden_sample).

dsa_names.description: DSA bank problems: how the bank's function and parameter names were renamed for this task (seed_id is the bank problem id). Case inputs use the renamed parameters. Absent or null for domain tasks and the P1.3 demo problem.

perf.description: Performance constraint. Null when the task has none.

random_seeds.description: Seeds used for generation, input generators and mutation testing, so the task can be rebuilt exactly.

ai_solve_rate.description: Fraction of probe-model attempts that passed all hidden tests.

difficulty_index.description: Computed difficulty estimate; higher is harder.

RelPath.description: Relative POSIX path inside the task repo. No leading slash, no . or .. segments.

propertyNames.description: Same rule as RelPath (inlined: the Python generator cannot resolve a $ref here).

TestFile.description: A test file. Test ids are the runner's ids for the tests it contains (e.g. pytest node ids).

DsaCase.description: One DSA test case. input: arguments passed to the entry function; expected: its expected return value. Both may be any JSON value.

comparator.description: How the backend compares an output with the expected value. Null means exact JSON equality.

Identifier.description: A name valid in both Python and JavaScript.

DsaNames.description: 1:1 renaming. parameters is in signature order (the JS harness passes arguments positionally in this order).

Comparator.description: unordered_list: the output and expected lists hold the same items in any order. float_tolerance: numbers may differ by at most tolerance (absolute), everything else exact.

input_gen.description: Name of the input generator the runner uses to build the timed input.

Certificate.description: Evidence from the validation gate (backend/gate) that the task is sound. Builders store a draft (booleans); the gate replaces it with counts.

reference_pass.description: Gate: 'n/n xR', tests (visible + hidden) the reference passed out of the total, the same in each of R runs. Boolean: a builder's draft, or a task stored before P2.7.

starter_fail.description: Gate: 'k/n visible', k of the n visible tests fail on the starter. Boolean: a builder's draft, or a task stored before P2.7.

mutation_score.description: Fraction of reference mutants killed by the hidden tests (gate with mutation testing on). Null when not measured; tasks stored before P2.7 hold a 0.0 placeholder.

stub_fail_rate.description: DSA: share of cases the weakest trivial stub (first argument, empty value of the return type, 0, None) fails. Null or absent for domain tasks.

bruteforce_agree.description: Deprecated, replaced by stub_fail_rate. Kept so tasks stored before P2.7 stay valid.

budget_ms.description: The task's perf budget (perf.budget_ms). Null or absent when perf is null.

changed_lines.description: Domain: lines that differ between the starter and the reference (a replaced line counts once). Null or absent for DSA tasks.

perf_ref_ms.description: Reference runtime on the perf input. Null when perf is null.

perf_naive_ms.description: Naive solution runtime on the perf input. Null when perf is null.
